tracks.narration: Let's draw a circuit and see what happens when we charge a capacitor.
Here is a simple R C circuit: a voltage source V naught, a resistor R, and a capacitor C.
When you close the switch — how quickly does the capacitor fill up?
The voltage across the capacitor rises exponentially: V of t equals V naught times one minus e to the minus t over tau.
The time constant tau equals R C tells us that after one tau the capacitor has charged to sixty-three percent of V naught.
